scientific_integrity: The stationary subset-coverage recursion is a known supporting identity, not the novel theorem; direct derivation and independent exact finite-state verification are included. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed c>0, p_n=c/n, uniform sampling and post-draw independent loss; the result supplies an exponential logarithmic rate only, not a limiting Exp law, prefactor or heterogeneous-sampling theorem. Independent priority verification is still pending.
title: Exact exponential completion rate in the vanishing-loss careless coupon collector
